author: jamesgJ7139JV

title: Just book it already
text: Don’t look any further! This tour was so amazing. Alfredo picked us up at hotels and drove us all over the alpujarras for the whole day. He is a great guide and super guy, such that the time just flies by, even in the van. The villages are so beautiful, the history is engaging and timely, and the food was delicious. I bought several things from Dani at the embutidos store, and I can’t wait to dive in. Thanks so much for a great day.
author: Christopher_H

title: Good experience and service
text: The guide/driver Alfredo was very pleasant, engaging, and a good driver. The itinerary was good and he also educated us about the history of the Moriscos at the Tablate bridge and told us interesting facts about the architecture and idiosyncrasies of the Alpujarras.
author: marf481

title: Wonderful tour of Las Alpujarras!
text: We had the best time exploring Las Alpujarras! The small group size (13 people) was perfect and made the tour feel very intimate. Alfredo was a fantastic guide—so knowledgeable. We loved learning about the local history, exploring the charming towns, and tasting the local products. Highly recommend this tour!

title: A must if you are in the area!
text: Great day exploring the beautiful villages! Our guide Michael was very engaging, he gave us lots of info, and also drove very safely (I had been a little worried about the mountain roads as I have a fear of heights but it was not a problem at all)!  We also had delicious (and plentiful) food! The tour is absolutely worth it!
author: June_P8

title: enjoyable tour of villages
text: Alexandra and Jose did a great job! The lunch was a traditional village lunch high on the processed meats and fried food. The villages were delightful and it was great to visit the ham shop and chocolate shops.
author: V530XNsoniaf

title: Wonderful and insightful experience!
text: We had an absolutely wonderful day in this amazing region in the mountains with our terrific guide Alfredo who was friendly, knowledgeable and tried hard to ensure the tour was enjoyable to all. (He thoughtfully addressed my special dietary restrictions throughout the tour which was greatly appreciated.) The tour featured some special sites and experiences that gave us a view into the everyday life of living in small, off-the-grid towns with friendly people, beautiful artisan work, and delicious food. We highly recommend this experience which was interesting, relaxed and fun. Thank you again,
author: Camye_S

title: Exceptional tour and...
text: Exceptional tour and amazing guide. We were able to adjust our time to meet with local artisans and this will be an experience we treasure for years to come. Highly recommend!
